scenario: My younger brother has been struggling in school, and my parents have asked me to help him with his online assignments. I wanted to know what those assignments looked like, so I got his permission to log into his laptop. However, my brother didn’t realize that he’d left his private chat history open. On his laptop, I found his chat history full of messages complaining about school. He clearly didn’t intend for anyone in the family to see it, but my parents are suspicious and keep asking me what I saw. If I expose my brother’s entire chat history to my parents against his wishes, my parents will be able to help my brother with what he’s going through. If I do not do this, my brother will continue complaining online.
entities: I,my younger brother,my parents,my younger brother's private chat correspondents
outcomes: My brother's private chat history remains hidden from my parents
My parents remain unaware of the full extent of my brother's school complaints
My parents do not gain the information they could use to help my brother with what he is going through
